- [ ] Not applicable; rendered output is unchanged.
- [x] Canvas, SVG, PNG, and PDF remain aligned.
- [x] Relevant before/after evidence is attached through the stable 171-variant gallery and per-capability primitive/public equality records.

## Contribution checklist

- [x] The change is one coherent conceptual change.
- [x] Earlier programs and caller-owned inputs remain immutable.
- [x] Source, tests, declarations, current contracts, public docs, generated references, and examples are synchronized where applicable.
- [x] Public API, persisted state, renderer-boundary, or package-boundary decisions were agreed before implementation.
- [x] I reviewed and understand every submitted change, including AI-assisted changes.
- [x] I removed secrets, private data, generated caches, and unrelated edits.

title: Realistic generated scenarios omit Phase 8 public actions
body:
## Observed behavior

After the Phase 8 public actions were added, `npm run test:realistic` failed its generated-scenario contracts even though focused action tests passed:

- action cards exposed 217 user-facing actions while the locked count remained 208,
- nine public actions had no direct generated-scenario root call,
- the public option inventory and coverage-ledger totals still described the pre-Phase-8 declaration surface,
- Line source-label support changed the exact requirement sets for `createLinePlot` and `createParallelCoordinates`, but their locked digests remained stale.

Missing direct actions:

- `createIntervalPlot`
- `createRegressionPlot`
- `createDotPlot`
- `createLollipopPlot`
- `createDumbbellPlot`
- `editEndpointPlot`
- `createECDFData`
- `createECDFPlot`
- `editECDFPlot`

## Root cause

The focused W1/W2/W3 suites and action-card generation were updated independently from the realistic generated-scenario inventory. Static totals detected declaration growth, but the lifecycle recipe used to prove every public action remained unchanged. This left new public actions outside the broad corpus-based execution audit.

## Impact

- New hierarchical actions could pass focused tests without being exercised in generated realistic programs.
- Exact option-path and literal ledgers no longer represented the current type declarations.
- The realistic suite failed late, after long-running corpus checks.

## Fix

Implemented in `083880f70051af81b11b30e6f331bbd2d7c195db`:

- the direct resource lifecycle now calls all nine actions using concrete data and retains their final effects,
- `LIFECYCLE_EXPECTED_ACTIONS` includes the Phase 8 surface,
- declaration-derived counts now lock 217 public actions, 9,146 option paths, and 13,188 coverage requirements,
- affected exact requirement counts and SHA-256 digests were recalculated from the current declaration graph.

## Verification

- generated lifecycle scenarios: 3/3
- generated feature coverage: 7/7
- realistic Cartesian facade coverage: 6/6
- complete realistic suite: 243/243
- all contracts: 318/318

title: createIntervalPlot reuses unrelated global position scales
body:
## Reproduction

Starting from a program that already owns ordinary quantitative `x` and `y` scales, add a complete interval plot with a categorical x position:

```js
chart()
  .createCanvas({ width: 480, height: 320, margin: 50 })
  .createData({
    id: "source",
    values: [
      { category: "A", value: 1, x: 1, y: 2 },
      { category: "A", value: 3, x: 2, y: 3 },
      { category: "B", value: 4, x: 3, y: 5 }
    ]
  })
  .createScatterPlot({ id: "observed", x: "x", y: "y", guides: false })
  .createIntervalPlot({
    id: "estimate",
    data: "source",
    x: { field: "category", fieldType: "nominal" },
    y: { field: "value", center: "mean", extent: "stdev" },
    guides: false
  });
```

## Observed behavior

`createIntervalPlot` throws:

```text
Scale type "linear" is not valid for discrete position.
```

The failure is order dependent. The same interval facade succeeds in a fresh program, but fails after another layer has materialized the default global `x` scale as quantitative.

## Root cause

The complete interval facade forwarded normalized x/y channels to `createErrorBar` without assigning owner-scoped scale IDs. The lower-level error-bar path therefore fell back to channel-global scale IDs (`x` and `y`). A prior layer could fix `x` as linear before the interval facade tried to use it for a nominal position.

This violates complete-facade isolation: an explicitly named interval plot should own stable position scales unless the caller supplies scale IDs for intentional sharing.

## Impact

- Valid multi-layer authoring becomes order dependent.
- A categorical interval plot cannot be added after a common quantitative chart.
- The failure is caused by unrelated earlier state and is difficult to diagnose from the public call.
- The interval point and error-bar children cannot reliably preserve their shared scale identity in larger programs.

## Expected behavior

`createIntervalPlot({ id: "estimate", ... })` should default to `estimateX` and `estimateY`, while preserving caller-provided scale IDs. Its point and error-bar children should share those owner-scoped scales. In the reproduction, `estimateX` should resolve to a discrete point scale and `estimateY` to a linear scale.

## Regression coverage

Add a unit case that first creates a quantitative scatter layer, then creates the categorical interval plot and asserts:

- no exception,
- interval and point children both reference `estimateX` / `estimateY`,
- `estimateX.type === "point"`,
- `estimateY.type === "linear"`.

title: Support channel-specific scale editors such as editColorScale, editXScale, and editSizeScale
body:
## Request

Add discoverable, channel-specific scale-editing actions, beginning with `editColorScale`, with a consistent family for position and appearance channels.

The existing `editScale` already edits scales and refreshes consumers. This request is for a public authoring layer that expresses which channel is being edited and resolves its scale without requiring users to know the scale ID or rely on the last current scale.

## Concrete use case

A Nightingale-style publication teaser starts with `createRosePlot`, refines the radial encoding, and ends by changing the cause palette. The intended last action is:

```js
.editColorScale({
  range: ["#315A8A", "#4F7D5C", "#9A4D55"]
});
```

The current equivalent is:

```js
.editScale({
  id: "color", // requires knowing the actual encoded scale ID
  range: ["#315A8A", "#4F7D5C", "#9A4D55"]
});
```

## Current API check / minimal reproduction

On `codex/roadmap6-hierarchical-actions`, source snapshot associated with commit
`d2c2bf38e5d178b82156aab3fbc55e4fed19ca7a`:

```js
import { chart } from "ggaction";
const p = chart();
console.log(typeof p.editScale);      // "function"
console.log(typeof p.editColorScale); // "undefined"
```

The new name is absent from the scale-action registration and public TypeScript declaration. This is a feature request, not a claim that `editScale` cannot perform these edits.

## Suggested family

Names are proposals; please align them with the existing channel vocabulary:

- `editColorScale`: categorical palettes/ranges, continuous interpolation and domains, supported discretized color types.
- `editXScale`, `editYScale`: domains, nice/zero, log/pow/sqrt/symlog parameters, reversal, and supported categorical spacing.
- `editThetaScale`, `editRScale`: polar angular and radial position scales. Keep radial position distinct from graphical point radius.
- `editSizeScale`, `editOpacityScale`, `editShapeScale`, `editStrokeWidthScale`, `editStrokeDashScale`: the corresponding encoded appearance scales, with channel-appropriate options only.

For example:

```js
program.editXScale({ domain: [0, 100], nice: true });
program.editYScale({ zero: false });
program.editColorScale({ palette: "set2" });
program.editSizeScale({ range: [20, 200] });
```

These examples are proposed upstream APIs, not claims about current availability.

## Expected contract

1. Each action is a thin wrapped delegate to `editScale`, retaining its validation, immutability, trace, dependent rematerialization, and guide/legend transitions.
2. Accept an explicit `id` and/or mark `target`; if both are supplied, they must agree. Otherwise prefer the current mark's encoded scale, then a unique scale for that channel. Multiple marks sharing one scale still constitute a unique scale. Reject ambiguity rather than choosing the first candidate or an unrelated current scale.
3. Reject a scale bound to a different channel. A scale's name alone must not establish its role, e.g. a position scale called `color` is not a color scale.
4. Preserve field bindings, geometry unrelated to the edited channel, and compatible guide/legend styling. Refresh every consumer of a shared scale, not only the target mark.
5. Expose channel-appropriate runtime validation, TypeScript declarations, documentation and action metadata. Retain `editScale` for generic editing and orphan named scales.

## Local prototype and verification

A local-only `editColorScale` wrapper has been implemented for the teaser. It supports categorical and continuous palettes, explicit id/target resolution and the inference above, delegates to `editScale`, and rejects empty, conflicting, ambiguous and non-color requests. Five targeted tests cover these behaviors, including shared consumers and legend refresh. The resulting eight-action teaser was exported as PNG/SVG/PDF.

Only `editColorScale` is implemented locally; the other family members above are requested upstream. Related progressive-authoring request: #120.

title: Support refining createRosePlot into a cause-colored overlay without editSemantic
body:
## Request

Support converting a chart created with `createRosePlot()` into a row-level, cause-colored radial overlay through subsequent public authoring actions, without `editSemantic()` or knowledge of internal semantic property paths.

The use case is progressive authoring: start with a high-level chart action, then revise its encoding and appearance. A publication teaser uses monthly Nightingale-style data with multiple causes per month. The desired result retains equal-angle month bands, draws each cause's value separately, orders larger sectors behind smaller sectors within each month, and updates the shared legend to causes. It must not sum different causes into one monthly petal.

## Environment

- Branch: `codex/roadmap6-hierarchical-actions`
- Commit: `d2c2bf38e5d178b82156aab3fbc55e4fed19ca7a`
- `createRosePlot` is the measured-area facade on this development branch. This report does not assume it is available in the published package.
- The relevant facade, position-encoding, removal, arc-derivation, and scale-edit source files were compared with this commit before reporting.

## Minimal reproduction

```js
import { chart } from "ggaction";

const values = [
  { month: "April", cause: "Disease", value: 9 },
  { month: "April", cause: "Wounds", value: 2 },
  { month: "May", cause: "Disease", value: 4 },
  { month: "May", cause: "Wounds", value: 1 }
];

const base = chart()
  .createCanvas({ width: 600, height: 500, margin: 90 })
  .createData({ values })
  .createRosePlot({
    category: "month",
    value: "value",
    aggregate: "sum"
  });

base.encodeColor({ field: "cause", layout: "overlay" });
// Error: Measured Arc category "April" must resolve to one color value.

base.encodeR({ field: "value" })
  .encodeColor({ field: "cause", layout: "overlay" });
// Same error: re-encoding retains the previous aggregate and radial mapping.

base.removeEncoding({ channel: "radius" })
  .encodeR({ field: "value" })
  .encodeColor({ field: "cause", layout: "overlay" });
// Error: Measured Arc requires equal-angle categorical theta and count or sum radius.
```

## Current workaround

This does produce four sectors and a two-entry cause legend, but requires a low-level semantic edit:

```js
base
  .editSemantic({
    property: "layer[rosePlot].encoding.radius.aggregate",
    remove: true
  })
  .editScale({ id: "radius", radialMapping: undefined })
  .encodeColor({ field: "cause", layout: "overlay" });
```

The full 36-row Nightingale example was also rendered and visually inspected using this workaround: 32 nonzero sectors and three cause legend entries. The resulting encoding is row-level radial length, rather than the facade's initial area-proportional monthly sums. That transition should be explicit in the public API.

## Desired public API behavior

Provide a documented way to clear/replace the inherited radius aggregation and measured mapping atomically, then apply the existing `encodeColor({ field: "cause", layout: "overlay" })`. For example, a supported reset option on `encodeR`, or another focused public encoding action, would work. The exact API spelling is open; no implicit change of area semantics is required.

Acceptance criteria:

- Start from `createRosePlot` and reach the overlay using public authoring actions, without `editSemantic`, direct spec mutation, or recreating the mark.
- Preserve the dataset, month order, layer identity, and compatible styling while switching from category sums to individual row values.
- Recompute the radius domain from individual values and update existing radial guides and the cause legend consistently.
- Support the existing larger-first overlay order and zero-value handling.
- Document the semantic transition explicitly, including area mapping versus direct radial length.
- Keep the authoring sequence compact enough for an approximately eight-action example including canvas, data, styling, and title.

This is primarily a feature request for progressive refinement of the facade. The failed remove-and-re-encode path above may also warrant a separate lifecycle fix.

title: Type declaration rejects supported createErrorBar groupBy:false
body:
## Problem

`createErrorBar({ groupBy: false })` is a supported runtime path for explicitly disabling inferred grouping, and the current contract documents that `false` survives JSON serialization. The public `ErrorBarOptions` declaration only accepts `string`, so valid JavaScript usage fails under strict TypeScript.

The inconsistency also affects complete interval-chart authoring: a facade must be able to forward an explicit ungrouped request without weakening its declaration.

## Reproduction

```ts
import type { ChartProgram } from "ggaction";
declare const program: ChartProgram;
program.createErrorBar({ groupBy: false });
```

Current TypeScript result: `false` is not assignable to `string`.

## Expected

`ErrorBarOptions.groupBy` accepts `string | false`, matching runtime normalization, JSON behavior, `editErrorBar`, and the documented group opt-out contract. Derived `DatasetIntervalTransform.groupBy` remains the normalized string array and must not admit `false`.

## Scope

- Correct the public declaration only at the authoring option boundary.
- Add strict positive coverage through the Interval complete facade and focused declaration tests.
- Keep runtime behavior and normalized statistical provenance unchanged.

title: Polar and Radar facade types advertise unreachable guide options
body:
## Problem

Several hierarchical Polar/Radar facade declarations accept options that their runtime owners reject or cannot meaningfully satisfy:

1. Polar Scatter legends inherit the general `LegendSymbolRecipe`, so a top-level opacity-point recipe such as `{ type: "point", radius: 6 }` type-checks. A color legend routes it through categorical symbol normalization and throws `Unknown createLegend.symbol option "type"`; point glyph recipes must use `symbol.layers`.
2. Radar legends accept `order: { channel: "theta" }`. Radar requires every series to contain every theta category, while path appearance must be constant within each series, so a color legend cannot share the varying theta field.
3. Radar, Rose, and Radial Bar categorical theta axes/grids accept numeric `count` and arbitrary numeric label formats. Runtime categorical theta guides use exact category values and categorical labels accept only `"auto"`.
4. Polar/Radar path facades expose curve literals that runtime does not support beyond `"linear"`.

These declarations enlarge action-card inventories with impossible paths and cause generated authoring guidance to recommend calls that fail.

## Expected behavior

Public declarations, compact action cards, and runtime validation should describe the same reachable contract:

- Polar point color legends use swatch/layer recipes, not opacity-point shorthand.
- Polar legend linked ordering is limited to theta; Radar path legends use scale/value ordering only.
- Categorical theta axes/grids use exact values rather than numeric counts, with categorical label format `"auto"`.
- Polar Line and Radar curve declarations expose `"linear"` only until other interpolation is implemented.

## Fix direction

Introduce facade-specific legend and categorical-theta guide types, regenerate action cards and documentation machine artifacts, and add strict positive/negative TypeScript contract tests. Validate every remaining public option path and literal through realistic direct traces.

## Verification

- Polar, Radar, and measured radial TypeScript contract tests
- Generated action-card schema/snippet checks
- Five-dataset hierarchical facade option/literal/diversity matrix
- Full unit and contract suites

title: Facade guides throw for explicitly disabled direction-only branches
body:
## Problem

A chart facade fails when its resolved grid request contains only explicitly disabled directions. For example:

```js
chart.createHorizonPlot({
  x: "time",
  y: "value",
  guides: {
    axes: { x: false },
    grid: { vertical: false },
    legend: false
  }
});
```

The facade passes `{ vertical: false }` into `createGrid()`. `resolveGridOptions()` then throws `createGrid requires at least one selected direction` instead of treating the branch as intentionally empty.

A naive fix that drops any scoped guide object without an enabled direction also breaks Parallel facades: `{ coordinate: { ... } }` is a valid request for inferred Parallel field axes, even though it has no explicit direction key.

## Expected behavior

- An axes or grid branch whose explicit direction entries are all `false` is omitted without creating a guide or throwing.
- A coordinate-only axes request remains valid so Parallel facades can infer their field axes.
- Existing shared guide reuse remains unchanged.

## Root cause

`fulfillFacadeGuides()` scopes and validates an all-false grid before checking whether the branch has work. Axes and grids also require different empty-branch rules because axes may use a coordinate-only request for inference.

## Fix direction

Detect all-false directional requests before scoping. For axes, exclude the `coordinate` metadata key from the direction check and preserve coordinate-only objects. Add Horizon and Parallel regression coverage.

## Verification

- Focused Horizon empty-branch unit test
- Parallel facade and axis lifecycle tests
- Full unit and contract suites
- Realistic hierarchical facade matrix across five datasets

title: createGuides() throws after createScatterPlot() creates default axes
body:
## Summary

`createScatterPlot()` creates axes and grid by default. If later actions add new guide-relevant encodings or layers and the program ends with `createGuides()`, guide creation starts with the already-existing x-axis and throws instead of creating only the missing guides.

This prevents the progressive authoring sequence below from working unless the earlier high-level chart action is given `guides: false`.

## Minimal reproduction

Tested with `ggaction@0.0.12` and Node.js 23.5.0.

```js
import { chart } from "ggaction";

const cars = [
  { Displacement: 1, Acceleration: 2.0, Origin: "A" },
  { Displacement: 2, Acceleration: 2.8, Origin: "A" },
  { Displacement: 3, Acceleration: 4.1, Origin: "A" },
  { Displacement: 4, Acceleration: 5.0, Origin: "A" },
  { Displacement: 1, Acceleration: 5.0, Origin: "B" },
  { Displacement: 2, Acceleration: 4.2, Origin: "B" },
  { Displacement: 3, Acceleration: 3.1, Origin: "B" },
  { Displacement: 4, Acceleration: 2.0, Origin: "B" }
];

chart()
  .createCanvas({ margin: { right: 130 } })
  .createData({ values: cars })
  .createScatterPlot({ x: "Displacement", y: "Acceleration" })
  .encodeColor({ field: "Origin" })
  .editPointMark({ opacity: 0.35 })
  .createRegression()
  .createGuides();
```

## Actual behavior

```text
Error: createXAxisLine requires a missing x-axis line.
```

The error originates from `src/actions/guides/axes/lines.js:146` while `createGuides()` calls `createAxes()`.

## Expected behavior

`createGuides()` should create only the guide components that are still missing, including a legend that becomes applicable after later encodings or layers are added. Alternatively, the high-level chart action and `createGuides()` contract should provide a direct progressive-authoring path without requiring an early `guides: false` option.

## Workaround

Pass `guides: false` to `createScatterPlot()` so the final `createGuides()` action creates all guides at once.

title: Source-owned text pollutes scale domains and blocks source rebinding
Rule guide example omits required field type and misstates default appearance
body:
## Problem

The Rule mark guide's first example calls `encodeY({ field: "limit" })`, but Rule field positions require an explicit field type. Copying the published example throws instead of producing a threshold line. After adding the field type, the snippet also needs `createCanvas` before position materialization; without it, layout rejects missing dimensions and margin. The same guide says creation assigns no style, although Rule creation stores the theme mark color, stroke width 2, a solid dash pattern, and opacity 1.

## Reproduction

Against commit `4d84a5585cf667b8ccc02b8cb7a1f8cb8dde521f`:

```js
import { chart } from "ggaction";
chart().createData({ values: [{ limit: 25 }] })
  .createRuleMark()
  .encodeY({ field: "limit" });
```

The Rule encoder rejects the missing `fieldType`. This is a documentation mismatch, not a request to change the existing Rule inference contract.

## Expected correction

Add the chart import and `createCanvas` setup, then use `encodeY({ field: "limit", fieldType: "quantitative" })` and describe the actual initial appearance. Keep the generated LLM guide synchronized. The corrected call should materialize one constant-height horizontal line, and the subsequent explicit stroke/width actions should remain editable.

## Affected source

`docs/api/marks/rule.md`, generated `docs/llms-full.txt`.

title: Rect temporal selection channels bypass timestamp normalization
body:
## Problem

Temporal Rect geometry uses normalized timestamps, but final-item selection channels return the original source strings (or the original numeric unit). This violates the `selectMarks` contract that `channel` is the resolved semantic value before scale mapping. Point and Rule adapters normalize temporal channels.

## Reproduction

```js
const p = chart().createCanvas()
  .createData({ values: [{ start: '2020-01-01', end: '2020-01-03', low: 0, high: 1 }] })
  .createRectMark({ data: 'data' })
  .encodeX({ field: 'start', fieldType: 'temporal' })
  .encodeY({ field: 'low' })
  .encodeX2({ field: 'end', fieldType: 'temporal' })
  .encodeY2({ field: 'high' });
p.selectMarks({ target: 'rect', channel: 'x', op: 'gte', value: Date.UTC(2020, 0, 1) });
```

Expected: the single Rect is selected. Its `fields.start` remains the original string, while `channels.x` is `1577836800000`.
Actual: selection returns no keys because `channels.x` is `'2020-01-01'`. The comparison deliberately does not coerce types. The geometry itself is correct, making the failure easy to miss.

## Cause and impact

`src/materialization/rect.js` builds channels directly from `row[encoding.field]`, and the Rect selection adapter forwards those values. It bypasses the shared `channelMapFromRow` normalization used by Point and the special gradient Rect path. Numeric calendar years have the same problem: positions normalize to epoch milliseconds while selection uses the original year numbers.

This affects channel-based selection, inline highlighting, and `filterMarks`; raw-field selection should retain its existing source-value semantics. The new constant Rect endpoints also need to match equivalent field endpoints at selection grain.

## Fix and validation

Use the shared selection channel resolver for ordinary Rect final rows, preserving field/member identity and concrete geometry. Cover ISO dates and numeric calendar years, both endpoints and continuous temporal color, field-vs-datum parity, raw fields, selection/highlight/filter, and scale/Canvas replay. Run cumulative, type, renderer, and installed package/browser checks before closing.

title: TextFormat declarations accept precision tokens rejected at runtime
body:
## 문제와 재현

기존 TextFormat 선언은 임의의 number precision을 가진 fixed-decimal template을 사용하므로 `.13f`, `.-1f`, `.1.5f`를 TypeScript가 허용합니다. 실제 `validateTextFormat`은 0–12 자리의 정수 precision만 허용하므로 이 코드들은 실행 시 오류가 납니다.

Strict TypeScript/NodeNext probe로 위 세 token을 `chart().encodeText({value:1,format:...})`에 전달해 컴파일 exit 0을 확인했습니다. 같은 token을 runtime validator에 전달하면 각각 최대 12자리 초과/잘못된 fixed-decimal token 오류가 납니다. Probe는 `.artifacts/roadmap6-authoring/text-format-type-baseline.mts`에 보관했습니다.

## 수정 방향

TextFormat precision을 런타임에서 허용하는 정수 0–12로 제한합니다. 기존 런타임이 허용하던 두 자리 zero-padded `00`–`09` 표기는 타입에서도 보존하여 유효한 기존 입력을 막지 않습니다. 새 percent format에도 같은 precision 계약을 사용합니다.

Installed TypeScript probe에서 정상 fixed/percent/zero-padded 입력을 허용하고, 13자리·음수·소수 precision을 거부하는지 검증한 뒤 commit/push하고 종료합니다.

title: Histogram labels make Canvas resize fail as unbinned scale consumers
body:
## 문제

Histogram에 `createTextMark({ text: "bin" })`로 라벨을 붙이면 최초 렌더는 성공하지만 `editCanvas`로 크기를 바꿀 때 `Binned scale "x" cannot be shared with an unbinned consumer.` 오류가 납니다. 기존 constant/field 라벨에서도 발생하므로 새 semantic content만의 문제가 아닙니다.

## 재현

```js
const p = chart().createCanvas({ width: 480, height: 360, margin: 50 })
  .createData({ values: [{ value: 1 }, { value: 1.5 }, { value: 3 }] })
  .createBarMark()
  .encodeX({ field: "value", bin: { boundaries: [0, 2, 4] } }).encodeY()
  .createTextMark({ text: "bin" });
p.editCanvas({ width: 600 });
```

현재 기준 `bf82f025`의 binnedPosition policy에서 재현: 최초 text items 2개, resize가 위 오류로 실패합니다.

## 원인

Text는 소스의 compatible x scale을 상속하지만 독립 binning consumer가 아닙니다. Binned position domain policy는 전체 consumer 수와 binned Bar/Line 수를 비교하므로 source-owned text도 unbinned consumer로 간주합니다. 또한 이런 라벨의 원래 dataset 값을 bin domain 계산에 섞으면 source filter/rebinding 이후 domain도 오염될 수 있습니다.

## 기대 동작과 수정 방향

연결된 text는 final source item anchor를 따르고 bin domain에 독립 raw row를 기여하지 않아야 합니다. Source 관계가 확인된 text만 binned domain consumer 검증에서 제외하고, bin domain은 실제 binned owners의 값으로 계산합니다. 진짜 independent unbinned consumer 혼합은 계속 오류여야 합니다.

Constant/semantic histogram labels, resize/scale/filter 후 bin boundaries와 label 값, 독립 text 혼합 거부를 검증하고 commit/push 뒤 종료합니다.

title: Attached text becomes stale after source position scale rebinding
body:
## 문제

소스 마크의 위치 인코딩을 새 scale ID로 재지정하면 attached text의 저장된 position encoding은 이전 scale ID를 유지합니다. 기존 `createTextMark()` 추론으로 만든 라벨에서도 발생하며, 새 `source` 옵션에만 국한되지 않습니다.

`getPositionEncodingMaterializationSteps`는 직접 마크와 같은 scale을 소비하는 마크만 갱신하고 semantic `source` dependent를 포함하지 않습니다. `editScale`의 후속 mark plan도 직접 scale consumer만 대상으로 합니다. 따라서 점은 새 위치로 이동하지만 라벨은 이전 위치에 남습니다.

## 재현 체인

```js
const p = chart().createCanvas({ width: 400, height: 320, margin: 40 })
  .createData({ values: [
    { x: 1, y: 3, x2: 2, label: "Alpha" },
    { x: 2, y: 5, x2: 3, label: "Beta" }
  ] })
  .createPointMark().encodeX({ field: "x" }).encodeY({ field: "y" })
  .createTextMark().encodeText({ field: "label" })
  .encodeX({ target: "point", field: "x2", scale: { id: "revised-x", domain: [0, 5] } })
  .editScale({ id: "revised-x", domain: [0, 10] });
```

기대: point x와 text x가 각각 `[104, 136]`으로 일치해야 합니다.

`55aa2de7`의 기존 editScale 모듈을 격리해, 직전 위치 재지정 결과가 올바르게 갱신된 프로그램에 적용한 probe에서도 points `[104,136]`, labels `[168,232]`가 나옵니다. 즉 첫 재지정의 stale 여부와 별개로 scale edit에도 dependency 누락이 있습니다. Probe는 `.artifacts/roadmap6-authoring/text-source-baseline.mjs`에 보관했습니다.

## 수정 방향과 검증

- Shared position materialization plan에 source-dependent text를 source 다음에 포함합니다.
- Scale edit은 직접 scale binding뿐 아니라 source relation의 dependent까지 갱신합니다.
- 미완성 source는 label item을 만들지 않고, position removal 때 stale label을 지운 뒤 position 복원 시 재생성합니다.
- Explicit source authoring을 추가하는 W3 기반 변경과 함께 point/bar/rule/rect/arc order independence, new-scale reassignment, scale edit, removal/restoration, filter/Canvas replay와 immutable state를 검증합니다.
- 구현·누적 검증·commit/push 확인 뒤 종료합니다.

title: Combined size legend title defaults depend on the original edge
body:
## 재현 기준

`e8c881627a0b65a9059b30e98e9ebb426c220dc5`. Color와 quantitative size를 인코딩한 Point.

```js
const left=base.createLegend({channels:['color','size'],position:'left'});
const moved=left.editLegendLayout({position:'right'});
const direct=base.createLegend({channels:['color','size'],position:'right'});
```

left의 size title fill은 `#334155`, right/top/bottom 직접 생성의 size title fill은 `#0f172a`입니다. Left→right 이동 후에도 `#334155`가 남아 동일 최종 옵션의 direct right 결과와 달라집니다. 통합9family×4edge matrix의 combined case에서 exact graphicSpec 비교로 재현했습니다.

## 원인

`categorical/actions.js`가 combined size의 inheritAppearance를 `position === 'left' || labels !== undefined || titleStyle !== undefined`로 정합니다. 위치가 appearance 상속 여부를 결정하고 이 flag가 편집에 남기 때문에 생성 이력에 따라 기본 스타일이 달라집니다.

## 수정 방향과 검증

위치와 무관하게 한 기본 스타일 정책을 사용합니다. 명시적 labels/titleStyle의 상속과 기존 standalone size appearance를 보존하고, 방향만으로 상속을 켜지 않습니다. Four-edge direct/moved parity, explicit/partial text styles, retained standalone companion, hidden/restore, Canvas/scale/encoding replay, primitive title-color target과 installed package/docs를 검사한 뒤 닫습니다.

title: Categorical side legends accept ignored layout options and reject a valid single column
Opacity legend point recipes are missing from TypeScript declarations
Categorical legends overlap with large fonts, strokes and mapped shapes
body:
## 재현 기준

`d3eb4ca0bd3b82fef9e8ecd1d626bf3c3ee2fa90`. 전체 item audit80조합 중32에서 겹침, 그중 범주형 color/shape/line에서24조합입니다.

## 재현과 관찰

```js
const base=chart().createCanvas({width:3000,height:2400,margin:700})
 .createData({values:[{x:0,y:0,g:"A"},{x:1,y:1,g:"B"},{x:2,y:2,g:"C"}]})
 .createPointMark().encodeX({field:"x"}).encodeY({field:"y"}).encodeColor({field:"g"});
base.createLegend({position:"right",labels:{fontSize:80}});
base.createLegend({position:"top",columns:2,symbol:{stroke:"black",strokeWidth:40}});
```

- Side categorical layout은 first center=plot.y+52, 이후 항목은 고정itemGap입니다. 큰 label/title 높이를 반영하지 않아 제목과 이웃 label이 겹칩니다.
- Swatch stroke40/offset8에서는 actual gap=-12px. Line width60/offset10에서는 -20px. 네 방향에서 symbol-label overlap. 
- Shape recipe `{layers:[{type:"point",size:30,stroke:"black",strokeWidth:40}]}`; mapped shapes triangle-up/square/cross에서는 actual gaps가 약[-35.044,-6.587,-22.129]px. 면적 정규화 path와 stroke bounds도 nominal size*2를 초과합니다. 

## 원인

`categorical/layout.js`의 symbolWidth 및 `layout/legend.js`의 measureLegendSymbolHeight가 실제 stroke/shape bounds 대신 nominal dimensions를 사용합니다. Side 고정 pitch도 텍스트 실제 높이를 무시합니다. Final outer alignment만으로 내부 겹침은 해결되지 않습니다.

## 수정 및 검증 범위

Actual per-item symbol extent를 먼저 측정하고 공통 label column, 최소 labels.offset, adaptive side pitch/title gap 및 horizontal grid를 일관되게 배치해야 합니다. 원형 외 mapped shape, layered line/point/swatch, 큰 글꼴, hidden/inline title, border, Canvas/scale/filter/edit/remove 및 shared lane을 검사합니다. Explicit legacy-bottom 고정 anchor도 별도 감사하여 불가능한 공간을 조용히 겹치게 두지 않습니다. 독립 primitive target과 package/browser/docs 검증 이후 닫습니다.

title: Item legend spacing ignores swatch and stroke-width sample extents
body:
## 재현 기준

`d3eb4ca0bd3b82fef9e8ecd1d626bf3c3ee2fa90`에서 확인했습니다.

## 문제

구간색(quantize/quantile/threshold) 범례와 연속 선 굵기 범례는 실제 stroke extent를 최종 외곽 bounds에는 포함하지만, 심벌과 label 사이 간격 및 항목 배치에는 포함하지 않습니다. 구간색 swatch는 strokeWidth=40에서 labels.offset=8인데 실제 gap=-12px입니다. 선 굵기 range=[2,60], count=3이면 default labels.offset=12에 대해 actual gaps=[11,-3.5,-18]px이며 뒤 두 label이 sample과 겹칩니다. Left/right/top/bottom 모두 재현됩니다.

구간색의 높이도 height+strokeWidth 대신 max(height,strokeWidth)로 계산하여 세로 항목, 다중 행, 제목과 겹칠 수 있습니다. 큰 Canvas에서도 재현되어 단순 margin 부족 문제가 아닙니다.

## 재현 호출

```js
const base = chart().createCanvas({width:3000,height:2400,margin:700})
 .createData({values:[{x:0,y:0,m:0},{x:1,y:1,m:5},{x:2,y:2,m:10}]})
 .createPointMark().encodeX({field:"x"}).encodeY({field:"y"})
 .encodeColor({field:"m",fieldType:"quantitative",scale:{type:"quantize",range:["red","blue","green"]}});
base.createLegend({position:"top",columns:2,symbol:{stroke:"black",strokeWidth:40}});
```

## 원인과 수정 방향

`src/layout/legendItems.js`가 nominal symbol.width/height를 사용해 자리를 배정한 뒤 stroke bounds를 늦게 합칩니다. Item별 actual local bounds를 먼저 측정하고 공통 sample slot을 확보해야 합니다. Labels.offset은 해당 slot의 오른쪽 실제 외곽 이후 최소 간격으로 적용하고, 폭이 다른 sample의 label column 정렬은 유지합니다. Size 범례의 minimum32 slot 계약을 보존합니다. Side pitch·title gap·horizontal grid·border·Canvas fit은 같은 extent를 사용해야 합니다.

## 완료 조건

네 방향, column/direction, title inline/hidden, large stroke/font, create/edit/scale/Canvas/content/filter/remove replay, immutable overflow를 검증합니다. 수정 전 작성한 독립 primitive와 public 결과의 graphics/order/PNG를 대조하고 기존 size/interval/width primitive 및 package/browser/docs 검증을 통과한 뒤 닫습니다.

title: Opacity legend samples overlap labels, titles and neighbouring items
body:
## Reproduction and impact

At `23a64dbcf28f8964cca1ed38acd58cb0b4f8316e`, sampled opacity legend layout measures raw radius and fixed item pitch before adding stroke extents. Large circles, heavy strokes, large labels or large titles can overlap within a successfully returned legend.

A 36-case audit covers six styles (default, radius40, strokeWidth40, label font80, title font80, and a mixed case) across both side positions and both horizontal title arrangements at top/bottom. **22 cases contain title/item, sample/label or neighbouring-item intersections; 20 cases violate the stored labels.offset.** Even default side legends subtract an unexplained 2px from the requested label gap.

Minimal example:
```js
const source = chart()
  .createCanvas({width:2400,height:2000,margin:500})
  .createData({values:[{x:0,y:0,m:0},{x:10,y:10,m:10}]})
  .createPointMark().encodeX({field:"x"}).encodeY({field:"y"})
  .encodeOpacity({field:"m"});
source.createLegend({channels:["opacity"],position:"right",count:3,
  symbol:{radius:40}}); // neighbouring circles and title intersect
source.createLegend({channels:["opacity"],position:"top",count:3,
  titlePosition:"left",symbol:{stroke:"black",strokeWidth:40}}); // circle strokes intersect labels
```

## Intended correction

Measure each sample as radius + half stroke width. Keep labels.offset as the actual visible edge-to-edge gap in all positions. Reserve at least 12px between a top title and item content. Side pitch remains a minimum center pitch and expands to fit the largest sample or label. Horizontal stacked samples retain the existing minimum pitch, expanding for sample/label width and itemGap; inline samples include stroke extents in their measured width. Hidden titles consume no space. Final Canvas overflow still fails immutably rather than silently growing the chart.

Create independent literal primitive targets before changing the public implementation. Verify positive/negative bounds, creation/editing/hidden title/content/replay/multi-block interactions, Full public package and exact graphics/order/pixels. This correction is one part of the remaining Roadmap6 W2 internal-spacing audit; other legend families remain to be audited.

title: Continuous legend creation and editing disagree on applicable layout options
body:
## Reproduction

At `980e9b2b1a9c4f4823ca87be4fc16d182118d36a`, a point chart with quantitative color or opacity accepts `createLegend({position:"left",align:"right"})` and stores the alignment, but renders exactly the same graphics as center alignment. Both side edges and both non-center alignments are affected: 8 combinations across gradient and opacity. Categorical, interval, size and width side legends require center alignment, as documented.

Gradient, opacity and interval also accept `titleStyle:{offset:100}` through both creation and editing. All 6 calls produce unchanged graphics. The public title-style type exposes typography and color only; label offset is a separate supported option.

Conversely, gradient creation accepts `titlePosition:"top"`, but `editLegend({titlePosition:"top"})` and `editLegendLayout({titlePosition:"top"})` reject it. Equivalent final valid options therefore differ by authoring route.

Minimal source:
```js
const source = chart()
  .createCanvas({width:1200,height:1000,margin:300})
  .createData({values:[{x:0,y:0},{x:10,y:10}]})
  .createPointMark().encodeX({field:"x"}).encodeY({field:"y"})
  .encodeColor({field:"x",fieldType:"quantitative"});
const legend = source.createLegend();
source.createLegend({position:"right",align:"left"}); // ignored
legend.editLegend({titleStyle:{offset:100}}); // ignored
legend.editLegendLayout({titlePosition:"top"}); // wrongly rejected
```

## Expected resolution

Reject non-center side alignment consistently, reject unsupported title-style offset without affecting labels.offset, and allow the supported top title position through gradient edits. Horizontal alignment remains supported. A horizontal legend with non-center alignment must explicitly change alignment to center when moved to a side; never silently discard stored intent. Rejections leave the previous program unchanged. Preserve valid existing concrete geometry, default settings and replay.

Evidence is a repository-local 21-case audit, including controls. Add Full/Basic creation, public/focused editing, aggregate creation, content/scale/Canvas replay and package/browser checks. This is part of Roadmap6 W2 option consistency; it does not complete remaining internal spacing or the final release.

title: Single horizontal legends align nominal geometry instead of occupied bounds
body:
## Bug

Single horizontal legends align nominal item grids or gradient endpoints rather than their final occupied bounds. Endpoint labels, shape/stroke extents, empty sample slots and borders move the visible result away from the requested alignment and offset.

Audit: seven families (color, series, gradient, interval, size, opacity, strokeWidth) × top/bottom × left/center/right × border false/true =84cases on Canvas1200×1000/margin300/offset40.66cases have a nonzero actual alignment error;48have a nonzero actual offset error.

Examples with a quantitative field0..10 and default font sizes:

- Gradient left alignment starts its first centered label3.66px before the requested plot edge; a border expands the error to16.16px.
- Gradient center is shifted1.83px because the last tick label is wider than the first.
- Opacity left alignment extends7px before the plot edge without a border,19.5px with one.
- Categorical and interval swatch stroke extents shift center by0.125px. Borders are excluded from align/offset.
- Size layout includes unused sample-slot width, so visible center can differ by6.618px.

## Expected correction

For a single top/bottom edge legend, resolve final concrete occupied bounds including visible text, actual symbol geometry/strokes and border, then place that whole block according to align and offset. Alignment uses plot left/center/right; top offset measures from plot top to occupied bottom, bottom offset from plot bottom to occupied top. Validate the final position against the fixed Canvas. Intrinsic coordinates are intermediate and must not cause premature Canvas rejection when final placement fits.

Keep explicit legacy-bottom fixed anchors and existing multi-block packing contracts separate. Public authoring, edit/remove/content replacement, Canvas/scale/encoding replay and Full/Basic creation must converge. This does not yet fix within-block spacing for oversized symbols/fonts, which remains part of W2 C2.

title: Hidden categorical titles still reserve space and cause overflow
body:
## Bug

Hiding a categorical legend title does not remove all of its layout contribution. Top/bottom edge layouts still use hidden title font height and title gap; inline layouts retain an empty title gap. Legacy-bottom borders still include the hidden title height.

Reproduce with a point chart on a 1000×800 Canvas, margin250, ordinal color or shape, two categories A/B:

```js
const hidden = source.createLegend({ position: 'top', border: true })
  .editLegend({ title: false });
hidden.editLegend({ titleStyle: { fontSize: 1000 } });
```

Actual: the edit can throw `Legend layout requires more top-margin space` although the changed text is hidden. In the default color example the top border retains25px of empty title space; the bottom samples are25px farther from the plot and the border is25px taller. Legacy-bottom border geometry changes when only hidden-title font size changes.

Baseline14cases (color/series, four edges plus legacy-bottom, horizontal top/inline title placement) yielded6spurious overflow errors,2changed hidden outputs and6unchanged outputs after a hidden-font-only edit. Inline hidden placement also retains a20px blank prefix.

Expected: hidden categorical titles contribute no text bounds, height or gap. Visible symbol/label positions determine the hidden border; restoration uses stored title/style and either fits or fails immutably. Explicit legacy-bottom sample anchors should remain fixed.

This is remaining Roadmap6 W2 C2 layout consistency work. It should preserve visible-title geometry, side defaults and renderer behavior.

title: Compatible color legend transitions still reject three supported edges
body:
## Inconsistency

Both gradient and interval legends now support all four Canvas edges, but switching the associated scale between sequential and discretized color still rejects every position except right. This affects both `editScale` and nested `encodeColor` type reassignment.

Minimal reproduction on a Full program:

```js
import { chart } from 'ggaction';
const p = chart().createCanvas({ width: 1200, height: 1000, margin: 300 })
  .createData({ values: [{ x: 0, m: 0 }, { x: 1, m: 10 }] })
  .createPointMark().encodeX({ field: 'x' }).encodeY({ field: 'm' })
  .encodeColor({ field: 'm', fieldType: 'quantitative',
    scale: { id: 'c', type: 'sequential', domain: [0, 10], range: ['blue', 'red'] } })
  .createLegend({ position: 'left' });
p.editScale({ id: 'c', type: 'quantize', domain: [0, 10], range: ['blue', 'red'] });
```

Actual: `Color legend transition requires right/vertical placement; remove and recreate the legend for other layouts.` Direct creation of the destination legend at the same edge succeeds. Baseline 8cases (both family directions × four edges) accepts2/rejects6 solely due to this stale placement restriction.

## Proposed correction and rationale

Preserve the requested edge and common alignment/style/title/border/offset when both families can represent them. Left/right use vertical placement and center alignment. Top/bottom allow left/center/right alignment with the default horizontal interval flow. Preserve the top-title contract. Continue rejecting custom gradient count/size, interval symbol/spacing/grid settings and any other family-only settings that cannot be represented without silently discarding user intent. Keep Full-only transition support and existing immutable overflow/collision failures.

This is the remaining Roadmap6 W2 C2 compatibility work; it does not require a new public action or a change to destination-family geometry.

title: Bordered continuous legends fail when a chart title already exists
body:
이미 chart title이 있는 program에서 bordered gradient/opacity legend를 생성하면 실제 공간이 충분해도 createGraphics cannot use before and after together 오류가 납니다.

원인: resolveLegendGraphicPlacement()는 기존 chart title 앞에 놓는 before를 추론합니다. Gradient/opacity symbol 생성은 그 반환값 뒤에 background 다음으로 놓는 after를 별도로 더해 서로 배타적인 두 anchor를 동시에 전달합니다. 반대로 editLegend의 reconcileGraphic은 caller가 지정한 before를 title anchor로 덮거나 after와 동시에 전달해 title/border 복원 순서가 잘못될 수 있습니다.

수정: 명시적인 before/after를 placement resolver에 함께 전달해 resolver가 default보다 explicit anchor를 우선하도록 합니다. Title-first/legend-first 생성, border on/off, hidden legend title 복원과 같은 최종 graphicSpec/draw order 및 원본 불변성을 검증합니다. #98의 family×edge×authoring-order 전수 검사 중 발견한 별도 원인입니다.

title: Guide collisions depend on legend family and authoring order
body:
Same-edge guide collision 검증이 family와 호출 순서에 따라 달라집니다. 7종(color/series/gradient/interval/size/opacity/strokeWidth)×4edge, Canvas1200×1000/margin300의 조사에서 28조합 중18개는 실제 겹침이 허용됐고4개는 축과 범례의 생성 순서에 따라 성공/실패가 달랐습니다.

대표 재현: size가 있는 point chart에 createLegend({position:"top",offset:40})와 createXAxisTitle({position:"top",offset:40,text:"AXIS",fontSize:24})를 순서대로 호출하면 두 guide가 겹칩니다. Categorical bottom은 축 제목을 나중에 만들면 겹침을 허용하지만 먼저 만들면 범례 생성이 실패합니다. Categorical left는 y-axis 전체 폭을 검사하는 별도 로직이 있어 실제 교차와 다른 거부도 발생합니다.

원인: categorical은 일부 top title/bottom axis title/left axis를 검사하고 continuous sampled families는 주로 Canvas bounds만 검사합니다. Chart title의 reserved graphic 목록에는 standalone size/width/interval이 누락돼 있습니다. 여러 guide의 Canvas replay 중에는 먼저 바뀐 좌표와 아직 바뀌지 않은 좌표를 비교할 위험도 있습니다.

수정 방향: resource policy가 알려주는 실제 visible graphics와 edge를 공통으로 수집하여 chart title·Cartesian axis component·legend group의 same-edge 충돌을 최종 concrete bounds로 검증합니다. Domain action과 guide/materialization transaction 끝에서 검사하고, nested child의 중간 상태는 완전한 마지막 배치 뒤 검증합니다. Primitive extension은 기존 직접 제어를 유지하며 Canvas/margin 자동 확장은 하지 않습니다. 생성/편집/remove/recreate/Canvas/scale replay 및 rejected program/trace 불변성, 실제로 겹치지 않는 positive controls를 함께 검증합니다.

title: Combined size legends overlap after horizontal layout edits
body:
현재 createLegend({ position: "top", count: 2 })는 categorical+size 결합에서 side 전용 오류를 냅니다. 그러나 같은 target의 right 결합 범례에 editLegendLayout({ position: "top" })를 적용하면 성공하고 범례들이 겹칩니다.

재현: Canvas1000×800, margin250, 두 point의 color g=A/B, size m=0/10, size range=[4π,36π]. Right createLegend({count:2}) 후 top 편집 결과의 실제 occupied bounds:
- color: x456.43–543.32, y205–242.25
- size: x439.02–574.98, y183–220
두 영역은 x456.43–543.32, y205–220에서 겹칩니다. 생성/편집이 동일한 최종 요청에 다른 계약을 적용하는 문제입니다.

원인: horizontal lane은 같은 target의 categorical+size를 한 group으로 합치지만 group 수가 1이면 즉시 반환합니다. 각 content owner가 독립으로 계산한 같은 edge 위치를 결합 내부에서 조정하지 않습니다. Size는 categorical position만 따르고 horizontal grid controls는 자기 side defaults에 남는 문제도 있습니다.

수정 방향: categorical+size 네 edge 계약을 생성·편집·content replacement에 통일합니다. Top/bottom에서는 두 content를 measured block으로 먼저 순서대로 배치하고 두 제목/항목과 nested size border를 포함한 하나의 group을 다시 측정합니다. 다른 범례가 있으면 이 group을 통째로 배치합니다. 실제 bounds와 border를 검증하고 Canvas/scale/filter/remove/recreate 순서의 수렴, 숨김 title, 명시적 grid와 align, overflow의 원본 불변성을 검사합니다. legacy-bottom은 결합 범례에서 명시적으로 거부합니다.

title: Size legend samples overlap labels and silently overflow the Canvas
body:
## 문제

Size 범례는 기본 sample center와 label 간격을 고정한 채 실제 반지름을 배치에 반영하지 않아 큰 원이 labels/이웃 sample을 덮을 수 있습니다. standalone 범례에는 Canvas 범위 검사도 없어 잘린 결과를 성공으로 반환합니다. 기준 commit: cb2361faf5bc7a9a2dcc9b0d434055ea1a3151ad.

## 재현

```js
const p = chart()
  .createCanvas({width:1000,height:800,margin:250})
  .createData({values:[{x:1,y:1,m:0,g:"A"},{x:2,y:2,m:10,g:"B"}]})
  .createPointMark().encodeX({field:"x"}).encodeY({field:"y"})
  .encodeSize({field:"m",scale:{range:[400*Math.PI,1600*Math.PI]}})
  .createLegend({channels:["size"]});
```

最大 sample 반지름은40인데 label anchor는 center+28이고 sample pitch는40이므로 라벨과 원, 인접 원이 겹칩니다. 큰 제목을 editLegend로 지정하거나 충분하지 않은 Canvas로 resize해도 bounds 검사가 없습니다. 결합 side lane도 shared label start44를 고정하여 큰 size circle이나 요청된 큰 label offset을 충분히 수용하지 않습니다.

## 수정 방향

Size는 최대 실제 diameter와 최소 sample slot32를 측정하여 공통 item layout을 사용합니다. Label offset을 sample slot 오른쪽 기준으로 통일하고 default12로 두면 보통 radius≤16의 기존 상대간격은 유지하면서 큰 원에도 여백을 확보할 수 있습니다. Side pitch는 실제 sample/font 높이를 수용하고 visible text/circle/border의 Canvas 범위를 검사합니다. Combined side lane의 shared label start는 기존44를 최소값으로 하되 각 block의 필요한 간격만큼 확장합니다. Explicit size label offset은 기존 center 기준에서 slot 오른쪽 기준으로 바뀌므로 문서와 회귀에 명시합니다.

Rejected creation/edit/resize/scale changes must preserve the original immutable program and trace. Hidden titles should not consume space. Retained nested size borders must move with their content and remain inside the shared group border.

title: Stroke-width legends silently overflow the Canvas
Hidden continuous legend titles still consume layout bounds
body:
## Reproduction

At `b17361a372e02007820f496d889ac81f28fd24c0`, gradient, interval and opacity legends include hidden title text in their occupied bounds.

Create a point chart on a 1600×700 canvas with right margin 1100, encode quantitative color or opacity, and call:

```js
.createLegend({ title: 'Long legend title '.repeat(6) })
.editLegend({ title: false })
.editCanvas({ width: 800, margin: { right: 300 } })
```

Use sequential color for gradient, quantize color with two class colors for interval, or field opacity for the sampled opacity legend. In each case the visible title graphic is absent and the remaining content fits, but resizing throws `... legend layout requires more Canvas margin space`.

## Expected and cause

Invisible title text must not enlarge the occupied content or background, or reject a Canvas that fits all visible components. The stored title text/mode should remain available for later restoration. Restoring a title that genuinely does not fit must still fail atomically.

All three continuous family layout functions unconditionally append title bounds, despite their materializers suppressing the title graphic when `titleVisible:false`. Horizontal inline opacity also reserves the hidden title's width, so its placement must be checked separately.

This should be corrected alongside the shared content/edge layout work, with hidden/visible title, background, resize/restore, inline opacity and four-edge regression coverage.

title: Automatic legend symbols stay stale after companion line changes
Categorical legend edits overwrite companion size styles
body:
## 재현 기준

Branch `codex/roadmap6-hierarchical-actions`, 기준 `0a5da6939b154df9bedf605aa59da829f7d364a2`. 기존 editCategorical의 무조건 inheritAppearance:true 처리로 발생한다.

```js
const original = chart().createCanvas({ width: 800, height: 700, margin: { right: 300 } })
  .createData({ values: [{ x: 1, y: 2, g: "A", m: 4 }, { x: 2, y: 3, g: "B", m: 16 }] })
  .createPointMark().encodeX({ field: "x" }).encodeY({ field: "y" })
  .encodeColor({ field: "g" }).encodeShape({ field: "g" }).encodeSize({ field: "m" })
  .createLegend({ channels: ["size"] })
  .editLegend({ labels: { color: "red" }, titleStyle: { fontWeight: 900 } })
  .createLegend({ channels: ["color", "shape"] });
const titleOnly = original.editLegend({ title: "Groups" });
const countOnly = original.editLegend({ count: 3 });
const labelWeightOnly = original.editLegend({ labels: { fontWeight: 700 } });
```

## 실제 결과

세 편집 모두 size 범례 label color가 red→#334155, size title weight가900→600으로 바뀐다. Categorical title만 바꾸거나 size sample 수만 바꿔도 size의 별도 설정을 잃는다. Labels의 fontWeight 한 속성을 바꾸는 경우에도 label color와 title fontWeight까지 덮어쓴다.

## 기대 결과와 원인

Omitted appearance와 nested style의 지정하지 않은 leaves는 보존해야 한다. Count/title 편집은 size style을 변경하지 않아야 하며 shared label/title style patch도 명시한 leaves만 각 block의 기존 effective style에 병합해야 한다.

기존 editCategorical은 size가 있으면 매번 inheritAppearance:true를 저장한다. Size materializer가 이 플래그를 읽어 기존 size config 대신 categorical의 전체 labels/titleStyle을 사용하면서 설정이 사라진다.

## 검증 방향

Count/title-only와 부분 label/titleStyle patch, 기존 inherited size의28px offset, standalone size 편집→categorical 추가, content 교체와 기존 edit의 동일한 병합 정책, scale/Canvas replay와 prior-program 불변성을 검사한다.

title: Removing an encoding restores a hidden legend title
body:
## 재현 기준

Branch `codex/roadmap6-hierarchical-actions`, commit `957ef31d1830ed3bb2306c66113088aaab59df8b`.

```js
const original = chart()
  .createCanvas({ width: 800, height: 700, margin: { right: 300 } })
  .createData({ values: [{ x: 1, y: 2, g: "A" }, { x: 2, y: 3, g: "B" }] })
  .createPointMark().encodeX({ field: "x" }).encodeY({ field: "y" })
  .encodeColor({ field: "g" }).encodeShape({ field: "g" })
  .createLegend().editLegend({ title: false });
const removed = original.removeEncoding({ channel: "shape" });
```

## 실제 결과와 기대 결과

기존 series 범례 config의 titleVisible은 false이고 title graphic도 없다. Shape encoding을 제거하면 color 범례를 다시 생성하는 과정에서 titleVisible이 true가 되고 colorLegendTitle이 다시 나타난다. 제목을 숨겼다는 사용자의 명시적 결정은 encoding 제거 이후에도 보존되어야 한다.

## 원인과 영향

`src/actions/encodings/remove.js`의 `reconcileCategoricalLegend`는 저장된 options 일부를 복사해 createLegend로 재생성한다. 이 복사에는 titleVisible이 포함되지 않고 createCategoricalLegend는 항상 titleVisible:true를 기록한다. 따라서 부분 encoding 제거 후 categorical owner가 바뀌거나 남은 채널로 재작성될 때 hidden title 설정을 잃는다. 같은 재작성 경로가 범례 content 부분 제거에도 재사용되면 오류가 확산될 수 있다.

## 수정 및 검증 방향

범례 content revision의 단일 owner가 남은 channels/domain/scales/recipe를 계산하면서 title visibility, inferred/custom title, styles, order와 recipe provenance를 보존하도록 한다. Shape/color/dash 제거, hidden→auto 복원, Canvas/scale replay와 불변성을 검사하며 legend-only 부분 제거는 mark encodings를 유지해야 한다.

title: Point legend inference falls back to line symbols and omits size content
body:
## 재현 기준

`96c01b5e` 및 Phase5 W2 B1 작업 중 확인. 800×700 Canvas/right margin300, x/y가 완성된 Point에서:

- color만 인코딩하고 `createLegend()` → series block의 line symbol.
- shape만 인코딩하고 `createLegend()` → series block의 line symbol. Shape를 설명하는 point layer가 없음.
- color+size 인코딩 후 `createLegend()` → series block만 생성, size 범례 누락.

반면 explicit `channels:["color"]`는 swatch, explicit shape는 typed point이고 color+shape+size를 모두 인코딩한 inferred path는 typed point + size입니다. Point에 shape/color가 추가되는지에 따라 기본 범례 내용과 recipe가 다른 정책으로 움직입니다.

## 원인

`resolveLegendKind`는 point의 color-only를 명시 배열에서만 분류하고, inferred point branch는 color와 shape가 동시에 존재할 때만 선택됩니다. 나머지 point inference가 line-series fallback으로 갑니다.

## 기대

동일한 mark와 채널의 inferred selection은 explicit selection과 같은 의미·recipe를 가져야 합니다. Color-only는 명시 color-only와 같고, shape-only는 typed point, color+size는 size block까지 설명해야 합니다. 기존 semantic kind/graphic ID를 소비하는 예제·하위 action·facade·MCP·package·primitive를 함께 migration하고, inferred size가 실제로 추가될 때 필요한 bounded layout을 검증해야 합니다.

이는 explicit selection 오류 #88의 수정만으로 완료되지 않는 별도 inference migration입니다. Roadmap6 Phase5 W2의 남은 content/inference 작업으로 추적합니다. 현재 완료로 표시하지 않습니다.

title: Legend symbol edits fail to preserve declared layer drawing order
body:
## 재현 기준

`96c01b5e`의 categorical editor. 기존 symbol recipe에 line과 point가 있을 때 `editLegend({symbol:{layers:[pointLayer,lineLayer]}})`로 선언 순서만 뒤집거나, point-only custom recipe에서 line+point recipe로 바꿉니다.

## 실제 동작과 원인

Editor는 symbol graphic ID를 Set으로 비교하고 기존 object를 남깁니다. 동일한 layer 집합의 순서 변경을 처리하지 않으며, 추가되는 layer는 기존 모든 layer 뒤/label 앞에 삽입됩니다. 따라서 stored recipe의 순서와 실제 drawing order가 달라집니다. Symbol 교체와 border:true를 같은 edit에서 요청하면 새 symbol이 만들어지기 전에 background의 before anchor로 새 ID를 사용해 실패할 수도 있습니다.

## 기대 및 수정 범위

선언한 recipe layer 순서가 실제 rendering 순서여야 하며 create→edit과 최종 recipe로 직접 create한 graphicSpec이 일치해야 합니다. Layer 집합/순서가 바뀌면 해당 symbol components를 선언 순서로 재생성하고, background는 anchor가 존재한 뒤 구성합니다. 기존 styles, title, semantic encodings, mark graphics와 이전 program을 보존합니다. 자동 recipe 복원 경로와 reverse layer + border 동시 편집을 회귀 검증합니다.

Roadmap6 Phase5 W2 B1 explicit/automatic symbol fidelity에서 함께 처리합니다.

title: Explicit legend channels add unrequested size and reject the complete selection
body:
## 재현 기준

`96c01b5e` 개발 브랜치. Point에 color/shape/size를 모두 인코딩하고 `createLegend({channels:["color"]})` 또는 `createLegend({channels:["shape"]})`를 호출합니다.

```javascript
const base = chart().createCanvas({width:800,height:700,margin:{right:300}})
  .createData({values:[{x:1,y:2,g:"A",m:4},{x:2,y:3,g:"B",m:9}]})
  .createPointMark({id:"p"}).encodeX({field:"x"}).encodeY({field:"y"})
  .encodeColor({field:"g"}).encodeShape({field:"g"}).encodeSize({field:"m"});
base.createLegend({channels:["color"]});
base.createLegend({channels:["shape"]});
base.createLegend({channels:["color","shape","size"]});
```

## 실제 동작

- `["color"]`만 선택해도 size 범례가 함께 생성됩니다. Color-only symbol도 다른 shape 인코딩의 존재에 따라 swatch 대신 point가 됩니다.
- `["shape"]`와 `["color","shape"]`에서도 선택하지 않은 size block이 만들어집니다.
- 필요한 세 채널을 명시한 `["color","shape","size"]`는 categorical-only validator에서 거절합니다.
- 같은 point에서 shape의 작성 여부만 달라져도 color-only 요청의 recipe와 자동 companion이 달라집니다.

## 원인과 기대

Point dispatch가 `channels`보다 기존 shape/size 인코딩의 존재를 우선하고, categorical validator에는 size를 분리하지 않은 배열을 넘깁니다. 자동으로 만든 point recipe를 explicit recipe와 구분할 provenance도 없습니다.

명시적 channels는 정확한 content 선택이어야 합니다. Categorical과 size를 분리해 각 owner에 전달하고, 제외한 encoding은 그대로 둔 채 해당 legend만 생성하지 않아야 합니다. Color-only는 shape 인코딩 존재와 무관한 swatch여야 합니다. 자동 recipe와 caller recipe를 구분해 후속 content 재작성에서 자동값을 explicit override처럼 보존하지 않아야 합니다.

Full/Basic 생성, invalid/duplicate/empty channels, target ambiguity, explicit combined size count/styles, encoding removal/scale/Canvas replay, 기존 inferred combined 예제의 보존을 검증합니다. Roadmap6 Phase5 W2 B 작업으로 처리합니다.

title: A label style edit silently changes legacy bottom legend layout
body:
## 재현 기준

`4d7e37d4` 개발 브랜치. Canvas height600, bottom margin150의 categorical legend를 `createLegend({channels:["color"],position:"bottom"})`로 생성한 뒤 `editLegendLabels({color:"red"})`만 호출합니다.

실제: label y가 `[572,572]`에서 `[489,489]`로 이동하고 private bottomGrid가 false→true로 바뀝니다. Font/color만 바꿨지만 Canvas-bottom compact mode가 reserved-margin grid로 전환됩니다.

원인: create의 normalizeOptions는 columns/direction/offset/titlePosition/itemGap option 존재 여부로 legacy/grid를 결정합니다. editCategorical은 보존해야 할 이전 값도 모두 normalizeOptions에 전달하므로 unrelated style edit가 항상 grid를 선택합니다.

기대: Omission은 기존 배치 mode를 보존해야 합니다. Legacy bottom placement를 명시할 vocabulary와 grid 선택을 드러내고, create/edit/Canvas replay에서 동일한 최종 옵션이 같은 위치로 수렴해야 합니다. 기존 implicit mode의 migration도 문서화해야 합니다. 이는 W2 layout 변경으로 처리합니다.

title: Shape-only legend recreation fails when an unrelated line exists
body:
## 재현 기준

`4d7e37d4` 개발 브랜치. Point에 color+shape legend를 만든 뒤 unrelated line mark가 있는 상태에서 `removeEncoding({target:"points",channel:"color"})`를 호출하면 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'field')`로 실패합니다.

원인: `resolveLegendCreationPlan`의 point branch가 remaining shape-only legend를 재생성할 때 matching line을 찾으면서 `requestedPoint.encoding.color.field`를 무조건 읽습니다. Color는 바로 앞에서 제거됐으므로 존재하지 않습니다. Line이 하나도 없으면 `some`이 단락 평가되어 동일 작업이 통과하는 순서/구성 의존 오류입니다.

기대: Point의 shape legend는 유지되고 color 설명만 제거되어야 합니다. unrelated line의 존재 여부는 결과를 바꾸지 않아야 합니다. 직접 shape-only create 및 color removal/replay 모두에서 의미·recipe·다른 layer 불변성을 검사해야 합니다.

title: Standalone size legend editors dispatch to an undefined continuous configuration
Parallel dimension reencoding leaves axis titles, ticks and scale bindings stale
editRadialAxis creates hidden layout state when no axis exists
body:
## 재현과 관찰

기준 commit: `5c9c79df`, Node 22.23.2.

```js
import { chart } from './src/index.js';
const p = chart();
const q = p.editRadialAxis({ angle: 45 });
console.log(q.guideConfigs.axis.radius); // { layout: { angle: 45 } }
console.log(q.semanticSpec.guides.axis?.radius); // undefined
console.log(Object.keys(q.graphicSpec.objects)); // []
```

Canvas, 데이터, encoding, 축이 전혀 없는데 edit가 성공합니다. 실제로 위 결과를 실행해 확인했습니다. 이후 첫 radial component의 각도 추론까지 이 숨은 설정이 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

## 기대 동작

`editRadialAxis`는 적어도 하나의 기존 radial 축 구성요소를 요구해야 합니다. 아무것도 없다면 명확한 existing-component 오류를 내고 semantic/config/graphic/trace를 모두 보존해야 합니다. 생성은 create 액션이 소유합니다.

## 원인과 수정 방향

`src/actions/guides/polar/axes/facade.js`의 aggregate editor가 axis 존재 확인 없이 먼저 layout.angle을 저장합니다. 이후 각 child는 graphic이 있을 때만 호출하므로 모든 child가 생략된 채 성공합니다.

공통 axis component 존재 확인을 먼저 적용하고, 마지막 구성요소를 제거하면 전체 remove owner로 남은 layout까지 정리합니다. 각도 변경과 component 제거를 함께 요청할 때에는 유지되는 component만 rematerialize합니다.

빈 chart 및 encoded-but-axisless chart의 실패 불변성, 부분 축의 angle 변경, 마지막 제거 후 config 정리, grid/mark 보존, 실제 설치 패키지 동작을 검증하고 수정 push 후 닫겠습니다.

title: Radial title preflight uses the default angle when the title is created first
body:
## 증상

Radial 축 제목을 첫 구성요소로 만들면 명시한 `angle`을 저장하기 전에 기본 각도(90도)로 공간을 검사합니다. 같은 제목을 같은 각도에 놓더라도 line을 먼저 생성했는지에 따라 성공 여부가 달라집니다.

재현 기준: `f4814aedc9a4faef65666d2447e4cdb4d430018a`, Node 22.23.2. 이 기준에서는 focused 생성 owner가 내부 wrapped 액션이며, Roadmap 6에서 이를 공개하는 과정에서 확인했습니다. 기존 완성 축은 line을 먼저 만들어 이 오류가 가려져 있었습니다.

## 최소 재현

```js
import { chart } from './src/index.js';
const p = chart()
  .createCanvas({ width: 300, height: 500, margin: 50 })
  .createData({ values: [{ angle: 0, value: 0 }, { angle: 10, value: 20 }] })
  .createPointMark()
  .encodeTheta({ field: 'angle' })
  .encodeR({ field: 'value', scale: { zero: true } });
const title = { angle: 180, position: 'outside', text: 'Long radial title' };
p.createRadialAxisTitle(title); // 잘못된 insufficient-space 오류
p.createRadialAxisLine({ angle: 180 }).createRadialAxisTitle(title); // 성공
```

기대 결과는 두 순서 모두 성공하고 동일한 제목 geometry를 만드는 것입니다. 이 Canvas에서 제목 위치는 x=150, y=358이어야 합니다.

## 원인과 수정 범위

`polar/axes/titles.js`의 생성 preflight는 `resolveAngle(this, kind, args)`로 요청 각도를 이미 결정해 놓고, `titleGeometry(this, kind, config)` 내부에서 저장된 각도 또는 기본 각도를 다시 읽습니다. 아직 angle이 저장되지 않은 첫 생성에서는 두 값이 달라집니다. Tick/label의 사전 geometry 계산도 같은 패턴입니다.

각 생성 owner의 preflight에 이미 결정한 각도를 전달하고, 편집 시에는 기존 저장 각도 조회를 유지합니다. 새 schema나 renderer 분기는 필요하지 않습니다.

## 회귀 검증

- 첫 제목 생성과 line-first 생성의 geometry equality 및 y=358.
- Theta/Radial 각각 24가지 구성요소 생성 순서.
- resize/scale 편집 뒤 스타일 및 기존 프로그램 불변성.
- Canvas/SVG와 실제 설치 패키지의 동일한 public chain.

수정 커밋을 push하고 검증 결과를 연결한 뒤 닫겠습니다.

title: Bar labels corrupt series scale domains or reject valid count resize
body:
## Problem

A source-owned Bar text layer is incorrectly counted as an independent raw-data consumer of its source's series scale. This can reject a valid resize for count bars and can expand a normalized stack's automatic domain beyond `[0, 1]`.

## Reproduction

```js
import { chart } from "ggaction";
const p = chart()
  .createCanvas({ width: 500, height: 350, margin: 50 })
  .createData({ values: [
    { category: "A", series: "x", value: 10 },
    { category: "A", series: "y", value: 30 },
    { category: "B", series: "x", value: 20 },
    { category: "B", series: "y", value: 20 }
  ] })
  .createBarPlot({ x: "category", y: { field: "value", aggregate: "sum" },
    color: { field: "series", layout: "fill" }, guides: false })
  .createTextMark()
  .encodeText({ field: "value" });
const resized = p.editCanvas({ width: 600 });
console.log(resized.resolvedScales.y.domain);
```

Expected domain: `[0, 1]`, with labels anchored to the final stack endpoints. Before the fix, raw label member values could expand the domain. A count Bar with an attached text layer could instead throw `Series layout scale "y" cannot be shared with another policy.` on resize.

## Cause and correction

`resolveSeriesLayoutDomain` classifies source-owned text as a direct consumer, although its values and positions are derived from the source's final items. Exclude text owned by a participating layout mark from independent direct consumers. Continue validating genuinely independent consumers so the fix does not relax scale compatibility generally.

Regression evidence covers count resize, normalized stack domain preservation, final endpoint labels and immutable previous programs.

title: Source-owned aggregate labels prefer repeated raw values over the final measure
body:
## Problem

Source-owned text can display a raw member value instead of the final aggregate. In a category with two identical measurements, the common raw field survives item grouping and takes precedence over the aggregate channel. A singleton count can similarly display the measured value rather than 1.

## Reproduction

```js
import { chart } from "ggaction";
const p = chart()
  .createCanvas({ width: 360, height: 240, margin: 30 })
  .createData({ values: [
    { category: "A", value: 1 },
    { category: "A", value: 1 },
    { category: "B", value: 5 }
  ] })
  .createBarMark()
  .encodeX({ field: "category", fieldType: "nominal" })
  .encodeY({ field: "value", aggregate: "sum", stack: null })
  .createTextMark()
  .encodeText({ field: "value" });
console.log(p.graphicSpec.objects.text.items.map(i => i.properties.text));
```

Expected: `["2", "5"]`. Before the fix: `["1", "5"]`.
Changing the aggregation to count should yield `["2", "1"]`, not the raw values. Measured Rose/Radial Bar labels have the same repeated-value failure.

## Cause and correction

`src/materialization/text.js` checked the common raw field before the source mark's aggregate measure. Resolve the Bar final measure endpoint and measured Arc radius aggregate first, while keeping category labels and non-measure fields unchanged.

Regression evidence covers sum/count/mean, singleton count, resize, measured radial filtering/highlight replay and immutability. This correction does not introduce percent labels or a new label API.

title: Fix audit defects in rematerialization, composition, transforms, and MCP
body:
Equivalent chart edits could leave stale scales or graphics, nested composition IDs grew exponentially, and the MCP resolver could recommend features explicitly excluded by a request. This change fixes the remaining audit findings and adds regressions for ownership, action-order convergence, numeric boundaries, and rendered output.

- Refresh remaining scale consumers when a mark or encoding detaches, while keeping incomplete points and lines empty until their position prerequisites are complete (#66, #68, #76). The shared-scale attachment and data-refresh fix for #64 is already on `main` in 8c38b971.
- Make nested graphic IDs grow linearly, preserve unrelated opacity legends, and accept valid prototype-named user IDs (#65, #67, #69).
- Reject unrepresentable UTC bucket starts and preserve own window output fields such as `__proto__` (#72, #73).
- Measure wrapped title bounds, keep promoted facet legends out of child replay, and preserve grid/label-leader draw order across edits (#71, #74, #75).
- Return explicit unresolved decisions and no authoring steps for unparsed negation, preserving the full request instead of reversing it. Quoted field names and known positive taxonomy phrases remain usable (#70).
- Correct coverage-suite setup, supported line/error-bar positions, opacity target support, and equal-area radius units; regenerate affected documentation (#77, #78).

Regression coverage includes 24 line-encoding permutations, deep composition growth bounds, immutable state, prototype-named outputs, and exact pixels for crossing grids and label leaders.

Validation passed locally:

- 2,316 normal tests, 53 browser tests, 137 rendering tests, and 167 realistic-corpus tests.
- Coverage: 94.95% lines, 90.84% branches, 98.73% functions; all 71 critical file floors passed.
- Packed artifact audit, 27 installed-package consumer checks, and 10 generated-document checks.
- 23,528 independent numeric checks; 611 unit-chart and 39 composition edits preserved their graphic snapshots. Six intentionally ineffective facet-scale edits were correctly rejected. Crossing label/grid pixels are identical across equivalent authoring and edit orders.

[CI](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/actions/runs/33940707743) additionally checks Node 20/22/24 consumers, all seven realistic-data shards, and the built documentation site on desktop and mobile.

The issue comments and closure will follow verified integration into `main`. No release or documentation deployment is included.

title: [Docs]: Capability tables and action contracts contain stale position, radius, and opacity restrictions
[Docs]: Test guide incorrectly says coverage includes realistic corpus tests
body:
## Problem

The [test guide](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/blob/fc45c3d5f518c8acc1ce4555d6db0896e56899c6/test/README.md#L18) says coverage includes both normal and realistic suites and therefore requires the local TidyTuesday corpus.

The current runner explicitly selects only normal suites for `coverage`. This gives contributors an incorrect picture of what a green coverage run has verified and which setup is required.

## Reproduction

At `fc45c3d5f518c8acc1ce4555d6db0896e56899c6` (package version 0.0.12):

```js
import { collectTestFiles } from "./scripts/run-tests.js";

const normal = collectTestFiles("all");
const coverage = collectTestFiles("coverage");
const realistic = collectTestFiles("realistic");
console.log({
  normal: normal.length,
  coverage: coverage.length,
  realistic: realistic.length,
  overlap: coverage.filter(file => realistic.includes(file)).length
});
```

Actual:

```json
{"normal":454,"coverage":454,"realistic":20,"overlap":0}
```

The [runner](https://github.com/ggaction/ggaction/blob/fc45c3d5f518c8acc1ce4555d6db0896e56899c6/scripts/run-tests.js#L110) uses `NORMAL_SUITES` for both `all` and `coverage`. The package commands are `node scripts/run-tests.js coverage` and `node scripts/run-tests.js realistic`, respectively.

## Expected correction

Document that coverage and realistic-corpus validation are separate gates. Explain `datasets:sync` as a prerequisite for the realistic suite, without claiming its tests are included in `test:coverage`.

This report asks to align the guide with the current runner/CI design, not to silently change the coverage suite's scope.

## Verification

During the audit, normal tests (2,273), coverage, and the separately executed realistic tests (167) all passed. The issue is inaccurate documentation of those boundaries.

Filed during a repository audit at the maintainer's request.
